Exod 35:14.e: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

Exod 39:37.o: אֶת־הַ/מְּנֹרָ֨ה הַ/טְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֗י/הָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַ/מַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְ/אֶת־כָּל־כֵּלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַ/מָּאֽוֹר׃
Exod 39:37.e: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

Exod 35:15.o: וְ/אֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/קְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ וְ/אֶת־בַּדָּ֔י/ו וְ/אֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֑ים וְ/אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַ/פֶּ֖תַח לְ/פֶ֥תַח הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
Exod 35:15.e: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

Exod 39:38.o: וְ/אֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/זָּהָ֔ב וְ/אֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֑ים וְ/אֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָ/אֹֽהֶל׃
Exod 39:38.e: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

Exod 35:16.o: אֵ֣ת ׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֗ה וְ/אֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔/וֹ אֶת־בַּדָּ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑י/ו אֶת־הַ/כִּיֹּ֖ר וְ/אֶת־כַּנּֽ/וֹ׃
Exod 35:16.e: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

Exod 39:39.o: אֵ֣ת ׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/נְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְ/אֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔/וֹ אֶת־בַּדָּ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑י/ו אֶת־הַ/כִּיֹּ֖ר וְ/אֶת־כַּנּֽ/וֹ׃
Exod 39:39.e: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

Exod 35:17.o: אֵ֚ת קַלְעֵ֣י הֶ/חָצֵ֔ר אֶת־עַמֻּדָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת־אֲדָנֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶ/חָצֵֽר׃
Exod 35:17.e: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

Exod 39:40.o: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶ/חָצֵ֜ר אֶת־עַמֻּדֶ֣י/הָ וְ/אֶת־אֲדָנֶ֗י/הָ וְ/אֶת־הַ/מָּסָךְ֙ לְ/שַׁ֣עַר הֶֽ/חָצֵ֔ר אֶת־מֵיתָרָ֖י/ו וִ/יתֵדֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֗ת כָּל־כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
Exod 39:40.e: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

Exod 35:35.o: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜/ם חָכְמַת־לֵ֗ב לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ ׀ וְ/חֹשֵׁב֒ וְ/רֹקֵ֞ם בַּ/תְּכֵ֣לֶת וּ/בָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּ/תוֹלַ֧עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֛י וּ/בַ/שֵּׁ֖שׁ וְ/אֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל־מְלָאכָ֔ה וְ/חֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת׃
Exod 35:35.e: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

Exod 38:23.o: וְ/אִתּ֗/וֹ אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־אֲחִיסָמָ֛ךְ לְ/מַטֵּה־דָ֖ן חָרָ֣שׁ וְ/חֹשֵׁ֑ב וְ/רֹקֵ֗ם בַּ/תְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּ/בָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּ/בְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֖י וּ/בַ/שֵּֽׁשׁ׃ ס
Exod 38:23.e: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

Exod 36:38.o: וְ/אֶת־עַמּוּדָ֤י/ו חֲמִשָּׁה֙ וְ/אֶת־וָ֣וֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/צִפָּ֧ה רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֛ם וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ פ
Exod 36:38.e: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

Exod 38:19.o: וְ/עַמֻּֽדֵי/הֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵי/הֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/צִפּ֧וּי רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֛ם וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
Exod 38:19.e: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

Exod 40:9.e: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

Lev 8:10.e: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

Ezek 1:16.o: מַרְאֵ֨ה הָ/אוֹפַנִּ֤ים וּ/מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶם֙ כְּ/עֵ֣ין תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ וּ/דְמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑/ן וּ/מַרְאֵי/הֶם֙ וּ/מַ֣עֲשֵׂי/הֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָ/אוֹפַ֖ן בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/אוֹפָֽן׃
Ezek 1:16.e: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

Ezek 10:10.o: וּ/מַ֨רְאֵי/הֶ֔ם דְּמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָ/אוֹפַ֖ן בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/אוֹפָֽן׃
Ezek 10:10.e: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

Ezek 1:17.o: עַל־אַרְבַּ֥עַת רִבְעֵי/הֶ֖ן בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֣/ם יֵלֵ֑כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּֽ/ן׃
Ezek 1:17.e: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

Ezek 10:11.o: בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֗/ם אֶל־אַרְבַּ֤עַת רִבְעֵי/הֶם֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּ֑/ם כִּ֣י הַ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִפְנֶ֤ה הָ/רֹאשׁ֙ אַחֲרָ֣י/ו יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּ/לֶכְתָּֽ/ם׃
Ezek 10:11.e: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

Ezek 1:18.o: וְ/גַ֨בֵּי/הֶ֔ן וְ/גֹ֥בַהּ לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/יִרְאָ֣ה לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/גַבֹּתָ֗/ם מְלֵאֹ֥ת עֵינַ֛יִם סָבִ֖יב לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּֽ/ן׃
Ezek 1:18.e: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

Ezek 10:12.o: וְ/כָל־בְּשָׂרָ/ם֙ וְ/גַבֵּ/הֶ֔ם וִֽ/ידֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/כַנְפֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים מְלֵאִ֤ים עֵינַ֨יִם֙ סָבִ֔יב לְ/אַרְבַּעְתָּ֖/ם אוֹפַנֵּי/הֶֽם׃
Ezek 10:12.e: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

Ezek 1:26.o: וּ/מִ/מַּ֗עַל לָ/רָקִ֨יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔/ם כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה אֶֽבֶן־סַפִּ֖יר דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א וְ/עַל֙ דְּמ֣וּת הַ/כִּסֵּ֔א דְּמ֞וּת כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֛ם עָלָ֖י/ו מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה׃
Ezek 1:26.e: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

Ezek 10:1.o: וָ/אֶרְאֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֶל־הָ/רָקִ֨יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים כְּ/אֶ֣בֶן סַפִּ֔יר כְּ/מַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א נִרְאָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶֽם׃
Ezek 10:1.e: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

Ezek 1:27.o: וָ/אֵ֣רֶא ׀ כְּ/עֵ֣ין חַשְׁמַ֗ל כְּ/מַרְאֵה־אֵ֤שׁ בֵּֽית־לָ/הּ֙ סָבִ֔יב מִ/מַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וּ/מִ/מַּרְאֵ֤ה מָתְנָי/ו֙ וּ/לְ/מַ֔טָּה רָאִ֨יתִי֙ כְּ/מַרְאֵה־אֵ֔שׁ וְ/נֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
Ezek 1:27.e: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

Ezek 8:2.o: וָ/אֶרְאֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה דְמוּת֙ כְּ/מַרְאֵה־אֵ֔שׁ מִ/מַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֛י/ו וּ/לְ/מַ֖טָּה אֵ֑שׁ וּ/מִ/מָּתְנָ֣י/ו וּ/לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כְּ/מַרְאֵה־זֹ֖הַר כְּ/עֵ֥ין הַ/חַשְׁמַֽלָ/ה׃
Ezek 8:2.e: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

Ezek 3:17.o: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִ/פִּ/י֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְ/הִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּֽ/נִּי׃
Ezek 3:17.e: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

Ezek 33:7.o: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִ/פִּ/י֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְ/הִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּֽ/נִּי׃
Ezek 33:7.e: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.

Ezek 3:18.o: בְּ/אָמְרִ֤/י לָֽ/רָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְ/לֹ֣א הִזְהַרְתּ֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א דִבַּ֛רְתָּ לְ/הַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֛ע מִ/דַּרְכּ֥/וֹ הָ/רְשָׁעָ֖ה לְ/חַיֹּת֑/וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/דָמ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
Ezek 3:18.e: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

Ezek 33:8.o: בְּ/אָמְרִ֣/י לָ/רָשָׁ֗ע רָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְ/לֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתָּ לְ/הַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֖ע מִ/דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/דָמ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
Ezek 33:8.e: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

Ezek 3:19.o: וְ/אַתָּה֙ כִּֽי־הִזְהַ֣רְתָּ רָשָׁ֔ע וְ/לֹא־שָׁב֙ מֵֽ/רִשְׁע֔/וֹ וּ/מִ/דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ הָ/רְשָׁעָ֑ה ה֚וּא בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/אַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ׃ ס
Ezek 3:19.e: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

Ezek 33:9.o: וְ֠/אַתָּה כִּֽי־הִזְהַ֨רְתָּ רָשָׁ֤ע מִ/דַּרְכּ/וֹ֙ לָ/שׁ֣וּב מִמֶּ֔/נָּה וְ/לֹא־שָׁ֖ב מִ/דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ ה֚וּא בַּ/עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְ/אַתָּ֖ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ׃ ס
Ezek 33:9.e: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

Ezek 5:7.o: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה יַ֤עַן הֲמָנְ/כֶם֙ מִן־הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/חֻקּוֹתַ/י֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וְ/אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽ/כְ/מִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃ ס
Ezek 5:7.e: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

Ezek 11:12.o: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/חֻקַּ/י֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽ/כְ/מִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
Ezek 11:12.e: You will know that I am Yahweh, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

Ezek 6:3.o: וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְ֠הוִה לֶ/הָרִ֨ים וְ/לַ/גְּבָע֜וֹת לָ/אֲפִיקִ֣ים ו/ל/גאית הִנְ/נִ֨י אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אִבַּדְתִּ֖י בָּמֽוֹתֵי/כֶֽם׃
Ezek 6:3.e: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

Ezek 36:4.o: לָ/כֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְ֠הוִה לֶ/הָרִ֨ים וְ/לַ/גְּבָע֜וֹת לָ/אֲפִיקִ֣ים וְ/לַ/גֵּאָי֗וֹת וְ/לֶ/חֳרָב֤וֹת הַ/שֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְ/לֶ/עָרִ֣ים הַ/נֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְ/בַז֙ וּ/לְ/לַ֔עַג לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִ/סָּבִֽיב׃ ס
Ezek 36:4.e: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

Ezek 9:8.o: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/הַכּוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/נֵֽאשֲׁאַ֖ר אָ֑נִי וָ/אֶפְּלָ֨/ה עַל־פָּנַ֜/י וָ/אֶזְעַ֗ק וָֽ/אֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הֲ/מַשְׁחִ֣ית אַתָּ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/שָׁפְכְּ/ךָ֥ אֶת־חֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
Ezek 9:8.e: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

Ezek 11:13.o: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/הִנָּ֣בְאִ֔/י וּ/פְלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָ֖ה מֵ֑ת וָ/אֶפֹּ֨ל עַל־פָּנַ֜/י וָ/אֶזְעַ֣ק קוֹל־גָּד֗וֹל וָ/אֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה כָּלָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ פ
Ezek 11:13.e: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

Ezek 12:13.o: וּ/פָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת־רִשְׁתִּ/י֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/נִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּ/מְצֽוּדָתִ֑/י וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֨י אֹת֤/וֹ בָבֶ֨לָ/ה֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְ/אוֹתָ֥/הּ לֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֖ה וְ/שָׁ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃
Ezek 12:13.e: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

Ezek 17:20.o: וּ/פָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלָי/ו֙ רִשְׁתִּ֔/י וְ/נִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּ/מְצֽוּדָתִ֑/י וַ/הֲבִיאוֹתִ֣י/הוּ בָבֶ֗לָ/ה וְ/נִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֤י אִתּ/וֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם מַעֲל֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעַל־בִּֽ/י׃
Ezek 17:20.e: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

Ezek 18:25.o: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑/י שִׁמְעוּ־נָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲ/דַרְכִּ/י֙ לֹ֣א יִתָּכֵ֔ן הֲ/לֹ֥א דַרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽנוּ׃
Ezek 18:25.e: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

Ezek 33:17.o: וְ/אָמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑/י וְ/הֵ֖מָּה דַּרְכָּ֥/ם לֹֽא־יִתָּכֵֽן׃
Ezek 33:17.e: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

Ezek 18:26.o: בְּ/שׁוּב־צַדִּ֧יק מִ/צִּדְקָת֛/וֹ וְ/עָ֥שָׂה עָ֖וֶל וּ/מֵ֣ת עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם בְּ/עַוְל֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יָמֽוּת׃ ס
Ezek 18:26.e: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

Ezek 33:18.o: בְּ/שׁוּב־צַדִּ֥יק מִ/צִּדְקָת֖/וֹ וְ/עָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל וּ/מֵ֖ת בָּ/הֶֽם׃
Ezek 33:18.e: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

Ezek 18:27.o: וּ/בְ/שׁ֣וּב רָשָׁ֗ע מֵֽ/רִשְׁעָת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָ֑ה ה֖וּא אֶת־נַפְשׁ֥/וֹ יְחַיֶּֽה׃
Ezek 18:27.e: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

Ezek 33:19.o: וּ/בְ/שׁ֤וּב רָשָׁע֙ מֵֽ/רִשְׁעָת֔/וֹ וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָ֑ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם ה֥וּא יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
Ezek 33:19.e: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

Ezek 45:6.o: וַ/אֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָ/עִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב וְ/אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְ/כָל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶֽה׃
Ezek 45:6.e: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

Ezek 48:20.o: כָּל־הַ/תְּרוּמָ֗ה חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף רְבִיעִ֗ית תָּרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֖ת הָ/עִֽיר׃
Ezek 48:20.e: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

Ezek 45:7.o: וְ/לַ/נָּשִׂ֡יא מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּה֩ לִ/תְרוּמַ֨ת הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְ/לַ/אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ/עִ֗יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֤י תְרֽוּמַת־הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְ/אֶל־פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ/עִ֔יר מִ/פְּאַת־יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּ/ה וּ/מִ/פְּאַת־קֵ֖דְמָ/ה קָדִ֑ימָ/ה וְ/אֹ֗רֶךְ לְ/עֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַ/חֲלָקִ֔ים מִ/גְּב֥וּל יָ֖ם אֶל־גְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָ/ה׃
Ezek 45:7.e: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

Ezek 48:21.o: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֣ר לַ/נָּשִׂ֣יא מִ/זֶּ֣ה ׀ וּ/מִ/זֶּ֣ה ׀ לִ/תְרֽוּמַת־הַ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ וְ/לַ/אֲחֻזַּ֪ת הָ/עִ֟יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֥לֶף ׀ תְּרוּמָה֮ עַד־גְּב֣וּל קָדִימָ/ה֒ וְ/יָ֗מָּ/ה עַל־פְּ֠נֵי חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ עַל־גְּב֣וּל יָ֔מָּ/ה לְ/עֻמַּ֥ת חֲלָקִ֖ים לַ/נָּשִׂ֑יא וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּ/מִקְדַּ֥שׁ הַ/בַּ֖יִת ב/תוכ/ה׃
Ezek 48:21.e: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

Ezra 2:1.o: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה ׀ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינָ֗ה הָֽ/עֹלִים֙ מִ/שְּׁבִ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶגְלָ֛ה נבוכדנצור מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל לְ/בָבֶ֑ל וַ/יָּשׁ֛וּבוּ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם וִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְ/עִירֽ/וֹ׃
Ezra 2:1.e: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

Neh 7:6.o: אֵ֣לֶּה ׀ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינָ֗ה הָ/עֹלִים֙ מִ/שְּׁבִ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַ/יָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/לִ/יהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְ/עִירֽ/וֹ׃
Neh 7:6.e: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

Ezra 2:2.o: אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְ֠חֶמְיָה שְׂרָיָ֨ה רְֽעֵלָיָ֜ה מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפָּ֥ר בִּגְוַ֖י רְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ס
Ezra 2:2.e: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

Neh 7:7.o: הַ/בָּאִ֣ים עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ס
Neh 7:7.e: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

Ezra 2:3.o: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:3.e: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

Neh 7:8.o: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Neh 7:8.e: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

Ezra 2:4.o: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:4.e: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

Neh 7:9.o: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Neh 7:9.e: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

Ezra 2:6.o: בְּנֵֽי־פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִ/בְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ יוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ ס
Ezra 2:6.e: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.

Neh 7:11.o: בְּנֵֽי־פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִ/בְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ וְ/יוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ ס
Neh 7:11.e: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

Ezra 2:7.o: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס
Ezra 2:7.e: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

Neh 7:12.o: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:12.e: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

Ezra 2:11.o: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Ezra 2:11.e: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.

Neh 7:16.o: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:16.e: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.

Ezra 2:12.o: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:12.e: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.

Neh 7:17.o: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Neh 7:17.e: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

Ezra 2:13.o: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּֽׁה׃ ס
Ezra 2:13.e: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.

Neh 7:18.o: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:18.e: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

Ezra 2:25.o: בְּנֵ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת עָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּ/בְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Ezra 2:25.e: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

Neh 7:29.o: אַנְשֵׁ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת יְעָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּ/בְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Neh 7:29.e: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

Ezra 2:26.o: בְּנֵ֤י הָ/רָמָה֙ וָ/גָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד׃ ס
Ezra 2:26.e: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

Neh 7:30.o: אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָֽ/רָמָה֙ וָ/גָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד׃ ס
Neh 7:30.e: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

Ezra 2:27.o: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:27.e: The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

Neh 7:31.o: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Neh 7:31.e: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

Ezra 2:28.o: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וְ/הָ/עָ֔י מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Ezra 2:28.e: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.

Neh 7:32.o: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וְ/הָ/עָ֔י מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Neh 7:32.e: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

Ezra 2:31.o: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס
Ezra 2:31.e: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

Neh 7:34.o: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:34.e: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

Ezra 2:32.o: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים׃ ס
Ezra 2:32.e: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

Neh 7:35.o: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים׃ ס
Neh 7:35.e: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.

Ezra 2:33.o: בְּנֵי־לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְ/אוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס
Ezra 2:33.e: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.

Neh 7:37.o: בְּנֵי־לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְ/אוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד׃ ס
Neh 7:37.e: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

Ezra 2:35.o: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ ס
Ezra 2:35.e: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

Neh 7:38.o: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ פ
Neh 7:38.e: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

Ezra 2:36.o: הַֽ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Ezra 2:36.e: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

Neh 7:39.o: הַֽ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
Neh 7:39.e: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

Ezra 2:37.o: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:37.e: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

Neh 7:40.o: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Neh 7:40.e: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

Ezra 2:38.o: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס
Ezra 2:38.e: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

Neh 7:41.o: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:41.e: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

Ezra 2:40.o: הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵי־יֵשׁ֧וּעַ וְ/קַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס
Ezra 2:40.e: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

Neh 7:43.o: הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵֽי־יֵשׁ֧וּעַ לְ/קַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י לְ/הוֹדְוָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:43.e: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

Ezra 2:41.o: הַֽ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה׃ פ
Ezra 2:41.e: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

Neh 7:44.o: הַֽ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:44.e: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

Ezra 2:42.o: בְּנֵ֣י הַ/שֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵי־שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵי־טַלְמ֣וֹן בְּנֵי־עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י הַ/כֹּ֕ל מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/תִשְׁעָֽה׃ פ
Ezra 2:42.e: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

Neh 7:45.o: הַ/שֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵֽי־שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵֽי־טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס
Neh 7:45.e: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

Ezra 2:43.e: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

Neh 7:46.e: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

Ezra 2:44.e: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

Neh 7:47.e: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

Ezra 2:45.e: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

Neh 7:48.e: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

Ezra 2:51.e: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

Neh 7:53.e: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

Ezra 2:52.e: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

Neh 7:54.e: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

Ezra 2:53.e: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

Neh 7:55.e: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

Ezra 2:54.e: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

Neh 7:56.e: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

Ezra 2:55.o: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־הַ/סֹּפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרוּדָֽא׃
Ezra 2:55.e: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

Neh 7:57.o: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סוֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־סוֹפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא׃
Neh 7:57.e: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

Ezra 2:56.e: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

Neh 7:58.e: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

Ezra 2:57.o: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמִֽי׃
Ezra 2:57.e: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

Neh 7:59.o: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֽוֹן׃
Neh 7:59.e: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

Ezra 2:58.o: כָּ֨ל־הַ/נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:58.e: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

Neh 7:60.o: כָּל־הַ֨/נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ פ
Neh 7:60.e: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

Ezra 2:59.o: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה הָֽ/עֹלִים֙ מִ/תֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדָּ֖ן אִמֵּ֑ר וְ/לֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לְ/הַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/זַרְעָ֔/ם אִ֥ם מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
Ezra 2:59.e: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

Neh 7:61.o: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה הָֽ/עוֹלִים֙ מִ/תֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדּ֖וֹן וְ/אִמֵּ֑ר וְ/לֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְ/הַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/זַרְעָ֔/ם אִ֥ם מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
Neh 7:61.e: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

Ezra 2:60.o: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Ezra 2:60.e: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

Neh 7:62.o: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי־טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
Neh 7:62.e: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

Ezra 2:61.o: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵי֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִ/בְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/יִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽ/ם׃
Ezra 2:61.e: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

Neh 7:63.o: וּ/מִן־הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִ/בְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/יִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽ/ם׃
Neh 7:63.e: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

Ezra 2:62.o: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛/ם הַ/מִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְ/לֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑אוּ וַֽ/יְגֹאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַ/כְּהֻנָּֽה׃
Ezra 2:62.e: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

Neh 7:64.o: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛/ם הַ/מִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְ/לֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַ/יְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַ/כְּהֻנָּֽה׃
Neh 7:64.e: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

Ezra 2:63.o: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד כֹּהֵ֖ן לְ/אוּרִ֥ים וּ/לְ/תֻמִּֽים׃
Ezra 2:63.e: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

Neh 7:65.o: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לְ/אוּרִ֥ים וְ/תוּמִּֽים׃
Neh 7:65.e: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

Ezra 2:64.o: כָּל־הַ/קָּהָ֖ל כְּ/אֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים׃
Ezra 2:64.e: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

Neh 7:66.o: כָּל־הַ/קָּהָ֖ל כְּ/אֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּֽׁים׃
Neh 7:66.e: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

Ezra 2:65.o: מִ֠/לְּ/בַד עַבְדֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/אַמְהֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְ/לָ/הֶ֛ם מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וּֽ/מְשֹׁרְר֖וֹת מָאתָֽיִם׃
Ezra 2:65.e: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

Neh 7:67.o: מִ֠/לְּ/בַד עַבְדֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/אַמְהֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְ/לָ/הֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּ/מְשֹׁ֣רֲר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס
Neh 7:67.e: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

Ezra 2:67.o: גְּמַ֨לֵּי/הֶ֔ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים׃ פ
Ezra 2:67.e: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

Neh 7:68.o: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה ס חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
Neh 7:68.e: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

Ezra 2:69.o: כְּ/כֹחָ֗/ם נָתְנוּ֮ לְ/אוֹצַ֣ר הַ/מְּלָאכָה֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּ֣אות וָ/אֶ֔לֶף ס וְ/כֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְ/כָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מֵאָֽה׃ ס
Ezra 2:69.e: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

Neh 7:70.o: וּ/מֵֽ/רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְ/אוֹצַ֣ר הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְ/כֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּ/מָאתָֽיִם׃
Neh 7:70.e: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

Neh 7:71.o: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָ/עָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְ/כֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְ/כָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה׃ פ
Neh 7:71.e: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

Ezra 2:70.o: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠/הַ/לְוִיִּם וּֽ/מִן־הָ/עָ֞ם וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְ/הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִ֛ים וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֖ים בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶֽם׃ ס
Ezra 2:70.e: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

Neh 7:72.o: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֡ם וְ/הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּ/מִן־הָ/עָ֧ם וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֛ים וְ/כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּגַּע֙ הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶֽם׃
Neh 7:72.e: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

Ezra 4:13.o: כְּעַ֗ן יְדִ֨יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְ/שׁוּרַיָּ֖/ה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן מִנְדָּֽה־בְל֤וֹ וַ/הֲלָךְ֙ לָ֣א יִנְתְּנ֔וּן וְ/אַפְּתֹ֥ם מַלְכִ֖ים תְּהַנְזִֽק׃
Ezra 4:13.e: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

Ezra 7:24.o: וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ם מְהוֹדְעִ֗ין דִּ֣י כָל־כָּהֲנַיָּ֣/א וְ֠/לֵוָיֵ/א זַמָּ֨רַיָּ֤/א תָרָֽעַיָּ/א֙ נְתִ֣ינַיָּ֔/א וּ/פָ֣לְחֵ֔י בֵּ֖ית אֱלָהָ֣/א דְנָ֑ה מִנְדָּ֤ה בְלוֹ֙ וַ/הֲלָ֔ךְ לָ֥א שַׁלִּ֖יט לְ/מִרְמֵ֥א עֲלֵי/הֹֽם׃
Ezra 7:24.e: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.

Ezra 7:14.o: כָּ/ל־קֳבֵ֗ל דִּי֩ מִן־קֳדָ֨ם מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָעֲטֹ֨/הִי֙ שְׁלִ֔יחַ לְ/בַקָּרָ֥א עַל־יְה֖וּד וְ/לִֽ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּ/דָ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖/ךְ דִּ֥י בִ/ידָֽ/ךְ׃
Ezra 7:14.e: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,

Ezra 4:15.o: דִּ֡י יְבַקַּר֩ בִּֽ/סְפַר־דָּכְרָ֨נַיָּ֜/א דִּ֣י אֲבָהָתָ֗/ךְ וּ֠/תְהַשְׁכַּח בִּ/סְפַ֣ר דָּכְרָנַיָּ/א֮ וְ/תִנְדַּע֒ דִּי֩ קִרְיְתָ֨/א דָ֜ךְ קִרְיָ֣א מָֽרָדָ֗א וּֽ/מְהַנְזְקַ֤ת מַלְכִין֙ וּ/מְדִנָ֔ן וְ/אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר֙ עָבְדִ֣ין בְּ/גַוַּ֔/הּ מִן־יוֹמָ֖ת עָלְמָ֑/א עַ֨ל־דְּנָ֔ה קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָ֖ךְ הָֽחָרְבַֽת׃
Ezra 4:15.e: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

Ezra 6:2.o: וְ/הִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בְּ/אַחְמְתָ֗א בְּ/בִֽירְתָ֛/א דִּ֛י בְּ/מָדַ֥י מְדִינְתָּ֖/ה מְגִלָּ֣ה חֲדָ֑ה וְ/כֵן־כְּתִ֥יב בְּ/גַוַּ֖/הּ דִּכְרוֹנָֽ/ה׃ פ
Ezra 6:2.e: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:

Ezra 4:21.o: כְּעַן֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ טְּעֵ֔ם  לְ/בַטָּלָ֖א גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֑ךְ וְ/קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָךְ֙ לָ֣א תִתְבְּנֵ֔א עַד־מִנִּ֖/י טַעְמָ֥/א יִתְּשָֽׂם׃
Ezra 4:21.e: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

Ezra 6:18.o: וַ/הֲקִ֨ימוּ כָהֲנַיָּ֜/א בִּ/פְלֻגָּתְ/ה֗וֹן וְ/לֵוָיֵ/א֙ בְּ/מַחְלְקָ֣תְ/ה֔וֹן עַל־עֲבִידַ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם כִּ/כְתָ֖ב סְפַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃ פ
Ezra 6:18.e: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

Gen 1:25.o: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֩ אֶת־חַיַּ֨ת הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לְ/מִינָ֗/הּ וְ/אֶת־הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל־רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֖ה לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
Gen 1:25.e: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

Gen 6:20.o: מֵ/הָ/ע֣וֹף לְ/מִינֵ֗/הוּ וּ/מִן־הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ מִ/כֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֖ה לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִ/כֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/הַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃
Gen 6:20.e: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

Gen 7:14.o: הֵ֜מָּה וְ/כָל־הַֽ/חַיָּ֣ה לְ/מִינָ֗/הּ וְ/כָל־הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ וְ/כָל־הָ/רֶ֛מֶשׂ הָ/רֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ וְ/כָל־הָ/ע֣וֹף לְ/מִינֵ֔/הוּ כֹּ֖ל צִפּ֥וֹר כָּל־כָּנָֽף׃
Gen 7:14.e: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

Gen 5:10.o: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י אֱנ֗וֹשׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת־קֵינָ֔ן חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת׃
Gen 5:10.e: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

Gen 5:16.o: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֗ל אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת־יֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת׃
Gen 5:16.e: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

Gen 9:12.o: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים זֹ֤את אֽוֹת־הַ/בְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֗ן בֵּינִ/י֙ וּ/בֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֵ֛ין כָּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם לְ/דֹרֹ֖ת עוֹלָֽם׃
Gen 9:12.e: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

Gen 17:10.o: זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֞/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֗וּ בֵּינִ/י֙ וּ/בֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֵ֥ין זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ הִמּ֥וֹל לָ/כֶ֖ם כָּל־זָכָֽר׃
Gen 17:10.e: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

Gen 9:13.o: אֶת־קַשְׁתִּ֕/י נָתַ֖תִּי בֶּֽ/עָנָ֑ן וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ לְ/א֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃
Gen 9:13.e: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

Gen 17:11.o: וּ/נְמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלַתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָיָה֙ לְ/א֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵינֵי/כֶֽם׃
Gen 17:11.e: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

Gen 33:19.o: וַ/יִּ֜קֶן אֶת־חֶלְקַ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה־שָׁם֙ אָהֳל֔/וֹ מִ/יַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־חֲמ֖וֹר אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם בְּ/מֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה׃
Gen 33:19.e: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

Josh 24:32.o: וְ/אֶת־עַצְמ֣וֹת י֠וֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱל֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל ׀ מִ/מִּצְרַיִם֮ קָבְר֣וּ בִ/שְׁכֶם֒ בְּ/חֶלְקַ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָנָ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב מֵ/אֵ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּ/מֵאָ֣ה קְשִׂיטָ֑ה וַ/יִּֽהְי֥וּ לִ/בְנֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף לְ/נַחֲלָֽה׃
Josh 24:32.e: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

Gen 41:45.o: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם־יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַ/יִּתֶּן־ל֣/וֹ אֶת־אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
Gen 41:45.e: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

Gen 46:20.o: וַ/יִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְ/יוֹסֵף֮ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לּ/וֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֣ן אֹ֑ן אֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְ/אֶת־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
Gen 46:20.e: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

Gen 41:50.o: וּ/לְ/יוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָ/רָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לּ/וֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן׃
Gen 41:50.e: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

Gen 46:12.o: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֧ר וְ/אוֹנָ֛ן וְ/שֵׁלָ֖ה וָ/פֶ֣רֶץ וָ/זָ֑רַח וַ/יָּ֨מָת עֵ֤ר וְ/אוֹנָן֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְ/חָמֽוּל׃
Gen 46:12.e: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

Num 26:19.o: בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עֵ֣ר וְ/אוֹנָ֑ן וַ/יָּ֥מָת עֵ֛ר וְ/אוֹנָ֖ן בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
Num 26:19.e: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

Hab 2:13.o: הֲ/ל֣וֹא הִנֵּ֔ה מֵ/אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/יִֽיגְע֤וּ עַמִּים֙ בְּ/דֵי־אֵ֔שׁ וּ/לְאֻמִּ֖ים בְּ/דֵי־רִ֥יק יִעָֽפוּ׃
Hab 2:13.e: Behold, isn’t it from Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

Jer 51:58.o: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת חֹ֠מוֹת בָּבֶ֤ל הָֽ/רְחָבָה֙ עַרְעֵ֣ר תִּתְעַרְעָ֔ר וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֥י/הָ הַ/גְּבֹהִ֖ים בָּ/אֵ֣שׁ יִצַּ֑תּוּ וְ/יִֽגְע֨וּ עַמִּ֧ים בְּ/דֵי־רִ֛יק וּ/לְאֻמִּ֥ים בְּ/דֵי־אֵ֖שׁ וְ/יָעֵֽפוּ׃ ס
Jer 51:58.e: Yahweh of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”

Mic 1:1.o: דְּבַר־יְהוָ֣ה ׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־מִיכָה֙ הַ/מֹּ֣רַשְׁתִּ֔י בִּ/ימֵ֥י יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־חָזָ֥ה עַל־שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
Mic 1:1.e: Yahweh’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

Hos 8:13.o: זִבְחֵ֣י הַבְהָבַ֗/י יִזְבְּח֤וּ בָשָׂר֙ וַ/יֹּאכֵ֔לוּ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָצָ֑/ם עַתָּ֞ה יִזְכֹּ֤ר עֲוֺנָ/ם֙ וְ/יִפְקֹ֣ד חַטֹּאותָ֔/ם הֵ֖מָּה מִצְרַ֥יִם יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
Hos 8:13.e: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

Jer 14:10.o: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה כֵּ֤ן אָֽהֲבוּ֙ לָ/נ֔וּעַ רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א חָשָׂ֑כוּ וַ/יהוָה֙ לֹ֣א רָצָ֔/ם עַתָּה֙ יִזְכֹּ֣ר עֲוֺנָ֔/ם וְ/יִפְקֹ֖ד חַטֹּאתָֽ/ם׃ ס
Jer 14:10.e: Yahweh says to this people: “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore Yahweh does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish them for their sins.”

Isa 2:2.o: וְ/הָיָ֣ה ׀ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית־יְהוָה֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הֶ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/נִשָּׂ֖א מִ/גְּבָע֑וֹת וְ/נָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו כָּל־הַ/גּוֹיִֽם׃
Isa 2:2.e: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

Mic 4:1.o: וְ/הָיָ֣ה ׀ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֗ים יִ֠הְיֶה הַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהוָ֤ה נָכוֹן֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הֶ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/נִשָּׂ֥א ה֖וּא מִ/גְּבָע֑וֹת וְ/נָהֲר֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו עַמִּֽים׃
Mic 4:1.e: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

Isa 2:3.o: וְֽ/הָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְ/אָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ ׀ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יֹרֵ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/דְּרָכָ֔י/ו וְ/נֵלְכָ֖ה בְּ/אֹרְחֹתָ֑י/ו כִּ֤י מִ/צִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּ/דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
Isa 2:3.e: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.

Mic 4:2.o: וְֽ/הָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְ/אָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ ׀ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָ֗ה וְ/אֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יוֹרֵ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/דְּרָכָ֔י/ו וְ/נֵלְכָ֖ה בְּ/אֹֽרְחֹתָ֑י/ו כִּ֤י מִ/צִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּ/דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
Mic 4:2.e: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;

Isa 2:4.o: וְ/שָׁפַט֙ בֵּ֣ין הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/הוֹכִ֖יחַ לְ/עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ/כִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבוֹתָ֜/ם לְ/אִתִּ֗ים וַ/חֲנִיתֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/מַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹא־יִשָּׂ֨א ג֤וֹי אֶל־גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/לֹא־יִלְמְד֥וּ ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃ פ
Isa 2:4.e: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

Mic 4:3.o: וְ/שָׁפַ֗ט בֵּ֚ין עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְ/הוֹכִ֛יחַ לְ/גוֹיִ֥ם עֲצֻמִ֖ים עַד־רָח֑וֹק וְ/כִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבֹתֵי/הֶ֜ם לְ/אִתִּ֗ים וַ/חֲנִיתֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/מַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹֽא־יִשְׂא֞וּ גּ֤וֹי אֶל־גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/לֹא־יִלְמְד֥וּ/ן ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃
Mic 4:3.e: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

Isa 15:5.o: לִבִּ/י֙ לְ/מוֹאָ֣ב יִזְעָ֔ק בְּרִיחֶ֕/הָ עַד־צֹ֖עַר עֶגְלַ֣ת שְׁלִשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֣י ׀ מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַ/לּוּחִ֗ית בִּ/בְכִי֙ יַֽעֲלֶה־בּ֔/וֹ כִּ֚י דֶּ֣רֶךְ חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם זַעֲקַת־שֶׁ֖בֶר יְעֹעֵֽרוּ׃
Isa 15:5.e: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

Jer 48:5.o: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה ה/לחות  בִּ/בְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה־בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּ/מוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַֽעֲקַת־שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
Jer 48:5.e: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

Isa 16:9.o: עַל־כֵּ֡ן אֶבְכֶּ֞ה בִּ/בְכִ֤י יַעְזֵר֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה אֲרַיָּ֨וֶ/ךְ֙ דִּמְעָתִ֔/י חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶלְעָלֵ֑ה כִּ֧י עַל־קֵיצֵ֛/ךְ וְ/עַל־קְצִירֵ֖/ךְ הֵידָ֥ד נָפָֽל׃
Isa 16:9.e: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

Jer 48:32.o: מִ/בְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה־לָּ/ךְ֙ הַ/גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל־קֵיצֵ֥/ךְ וְ/עַל־בְּצִירֵ֖/ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥ד  נָפָֽל׃
Jer 48:32.e: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.

Isa 16:10.o: וְ/נֶאֱסַ֨ף שִׂמְחָ֤ה וָ/גִיל֙ מִן־הַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל וּ/בַ/כְּרָמִ֥ים לֹֽא־יְרֻנָּ֖ן לֹ֣א יְרֹעָ֑ע יַ֗יִן בַּ/יְקָבִ֛ים לֹֽא־יִדְרֹ֥ךְ הַ/דֹּרֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃
Isa 16:10.e: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

Jer 48:33.o: וְ/נֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָ/גִ֛יל מִ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל וּ/מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְ/יַ֨יִן֙ מִ/יקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹֽא־יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃
Jer 48:33.e: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.

Isa 24:17.o: פַּ֥חַד וָ/פַ֖חַת וָ/פָ֑ח עָלֶ֖י/ךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃
Isa 24:17.e: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

Jer 48:43.o: פַּ֥חַד וָ/פַ֖חַת וָ/פָ֑ח עָלֶ֛י/ךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃
Jer 48:43.e: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says Yahweh.

Isa 24:18.o: וְֽ֠/הָיָה הַ/נָּ֞ס מִ/קּ֤וֹל הַ/פַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַ/פַּ֔חַת וְ/הָֽ/עוֹלֶה֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/פַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּ/פָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִ/מָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽ/יִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
Isa 24:18.e: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

Jer 48:44.o: ה/ניס   מִ/פְּנֵ֤י הַ/פַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַ/פַּ֔חַת וְ/הָֽ/עֹלֶה֙ מִן־הַ/פַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּ/פָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧י/הָ אֶל־מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃
Jer 48:44.e: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.

Isa 35:10.o: וּ/פְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשֻׁב֗וּ/ן וּ/בָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּ/רִנָּ֔ה וְ/שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑/ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂ֔יגוּ וְ/נָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַ/אֲנָחָֽה׃ פ
Isa 35:10.e: Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

Isa 51:11.o: וּ/פְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשׁוּב֗וּ/ן וּ/בָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּ/רִנָּ֔ה וְ/שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑/ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂיג֔וּ/ן נָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַ/אֲנָחָֽה׃ ס
Isa 51:11.e: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

Isa 41:18.o: אֶפְתַּ֤ח עַל־שְׁפָיִים֙ נְהָר֔וֹת וּ/בְ/ת֥וֹךְ בְּקָע֖וֹת מַעְיָנ֑וֹת אָשִׂ֤ים מִדְבָּר֙ לַ/אֲגַם־מַ֔יִם וְ/אֶ֥רֶץ צִיָּ֖ה לְ/מוֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
Isa 41:18.e: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

Ps 107:35.o: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽ/אֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְ/אֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְ/מֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
Ps 107:35.e: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

Isa 47:8.o: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה שִׁמְעִי־זֹ֤את עֲדִינָה֙ הַ/יּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָ/בֶ֔טַח הָ/אֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּ/לְבָ֔בָ/הּ אֲנִ֖י וְ/אַפְסִ֣/י ע֑וֹד לֹ֤א אֵשֵׁב֙ אַלְמָנָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע שְׁכֽוֹל׃
Isa 47:8.e: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’

Zeph 2:15.o: זֹ֞֠את   הָ/עִ֤יר הָ/עַלִּיזָה֙ הַ/יּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָ/בֶ֔טַח הָ/אֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּ/לְבָבָ֔/הּ אֲנִ֖י וְ/אַפְסִ֣/י ע֑וֹד אֵ֣יךְ ׀ הָיְתָ֣ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֗ה מַרְבֵּץ֙ לַֽ/חַיָּ֔ה כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשְׁרֹ֖ק יָנִ֥יעַ יָדֽ/וֹ׃ ס
Zeph 2:15.e: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

Isa 49:26.o: וְ/הַאֲכַלְתִּ֤י אֶת־מוֹנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֶת־בְּשָׂרָ֔/ם וְ/כֶ/עָסִ֖יס דָּמָ֣/ם יִשְׁכָּר֑וּ/ן וְ/יָדְע֣וּ כָל־בָּשָׂ֗ר כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔/ךְ וְ/גֹאֲלֵ֖/ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃ ס
Isa 49:26.e: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

Isa 60:16.o: וְ/יָנַקְתְּ֙ חֲלֵ֣ב גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/שֹׁ֥ד מְלָכִ֖ים תִּינָ֑קִי וְ/יָדַ֗עַתְּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔/ךְ וְ/גֹאֲלֵ֖/ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
Isa 60:16.e: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

Isa 51:15.o: וְ/אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ רֹגַ֣ע הַ/יָּ֔ם וַ/יֶּהֱמ֖וּ גַּלָּ֑י/ו יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ׃
Isa 51:15.e: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

Jer 31:35.o: כֹּ֣ה ׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה נֹתֵ֥ן שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לְ/א֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם חֻקֹּ֛ת יָרֵ֥חַ וְ/כוֹכָבִ֖ים לְ/א֣וֹר לָ֑יְלָה רֹגַ֤ע הַ/יָּם֙ וַ/יֶּהֱמ֣וּ גַלָּ֔י/ו יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ׃
Jer 31:35.e: Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar— Yahweh of Armies is his name, says:

Jer 4:4.o: הִמֹּ֣לוּ לַ/יהֹוָ֗ה וְ/הָסִ֨רוּ֙ עָרְל֣וֹת לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם פֶּן־תֵּצֵ֨א כָ/אֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗/י וּ/בָעֲרָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי/כֶֽם׃
Jer 4:4.e: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

Jer 21:12.o: בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּ֤ינוּ לַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְ/הַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִ/יַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק פֶּן־תֵּצֵ֨א כָ/אֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗/י וּ/בָעֲרָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מעללי/הם׃
Jer 21:12.e: House of David, Yahweh says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

Jer 5:9.o: הַֽ/עַל־אֵ֥לֶּה לוֹא־אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ/אִם֙ בְּ/ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּ/זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י׃ ס
Jer 5:9.e: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

Jer 9:8.o: הַ/עַל־אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא־אֶפְקָד־בָּ֖/ם נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּ/ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּ/זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י׃ ס
Jer 9:8.e: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on a nation such as this?

Jer 5:29.o: הַֽ/עַל־אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא־אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּ/ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּ/זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י׃ ס
Jer 5:29.e: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

Jer 6:13.o: כִּ֤י מִ/קְּטַנָּ/ם֙ וְ/עַד־גְּדוֹלָ֔/ם כֻּלּ֖/וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וּ/מִ/נָּבִיא֙ וְ/עַד־כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלּ֖/וֹ עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
Jer 6:13.e: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.

Jer 8:10.o: לָ/כֵן֩ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶת־נְשֵׁי/הֶ֜ם לַ/אֲחֵרִ֗ים שְׂדֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/י֣וֹרְשִׁ֔ים כִּ֤י מִ/קָּטֹן֙ וְ/עַד־גָּד֔וֹל כֻּלֹּ֖/ה בֹּצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע מִ/נָּבִיא֙ וְ/עַד־כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלֹּ֖/ה עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
Jer 8:10.e: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them. For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

Jer 6:14.o: וַֽ/יְרַפְּא֞וּ אֶת־שֶׁ֤בֶר עַמִּ/י֙ עַל־נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵ/אמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם ׀ שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/אֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
Jer 6:14.e: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.

Jer 8:11.o: וַ/יְרַפּ֞וּ אֶת־שֶׁ֤בֶר בַּת־עַמִּ/י֙ עַל־נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵ/אמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם ׀ שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/אֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
Jer 8:11.e: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.

Jer 6:15.o: הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא־יֵב֗וֹשׁוּ גַּם־הַכְלִים֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָ/כֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַ/נֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּ/עֵת־פְּקַדְתִּ֥י/ם יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ ס
Jer 6:15.e: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says Yahweh.

Jer 8:12.o: הֹבִ֕שׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא־יֵבֹ֗שׁוּ וְ/הִכָּלֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָ/כֵ֞ן יִפְּל֣וּ בַ/נֹּפְלִ֗ים בְּ/עֵ֧ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֛/ם יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ ס
Jer 8:12.e: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says Yahweh.

Jer 6:22.o: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן וְ/ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
Jer 6:22.e: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

Jer 50:41.o: הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מִ/צָּפ֑וֹן וְ/ג֤וֹי גָּדוֹל֙ וּ/מְלָכִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים יֵעֹ֖רוּ מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
Jer 50:41.e: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

Jer 6:23.o: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְ/כִיד֞וֹן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הוּא֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָ/ם֙ כַּ/יָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְ/עַל־סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּ/אִישׁ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּת־צִיּֽוֹן׃
Jer 6:23.e: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

Jer 50:42.o: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְ/כִידֹ֞ן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הֵ֨מָּה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָ/ם֙ כַּ/יָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְ/עַל־סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּ/אִישׁ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּת־בָּבֶֽל׃
Jer 50:42.e: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

Jer 6:24.o: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ אֶת־שָׁמְע֖/וֹ רָפ֣וּ יָדֵ֑י/נוּ צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְ/נוּ חִ֖יל כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
Jer 6:24.e: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

Jer 50:43.o: שָׁמַ֧ע מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־שִׁמְעָ֖/ם וְ/רָפ֣וּ יָדָ֑י/ו צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְ/הוּ חִ֖יל כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
Jer 50:43.e: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

Jer 7:6.o: גֵּ֣ר יָת֤וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָה֙ לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשֹׁ֔קוּ וְ/דָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ לְ/רַ֥ע לָ/כֶֽם׃
Jer 7:6.e: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

Jer 22:3.o: כֹּ֣ה ׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲשׂ֤וּ מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּ/צְדָקָ֔ה וְ/הַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִ/יַּ֣ד עָשׁ֑וֹק וְ/גֵר֩ יָת֨וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָ֤ה אַל־תֹּנוּ֙ אַל־תַּחְמֹ֔סוּ וְ/דָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה׃
Jer 22:3.e: Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.

Jer 7:16.o: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה אַל־תִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל ׀ בְּעַד־הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה וְ/אַל־תִּשָּׂ֧א בַעֲדָ֛/ם רִנָּ֥ה וּ/תְפִלָּ֖ה וְ/אַל־תִּפְגַּע־בִּ֑/י כִּי־אֵינֶ֥/נִּי שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אֹתָֽ/ךְ׃
Jer 7:16.e: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

Jer 11:14.o: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה אַל־תִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ בְּעַד־הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אַל־תִּשָּׂ֥א בַעֲדָ֖/ם רִנָּ֣ה וּ/תְפִלָּ֑ה כִּ֣י אֵינֶ֣/נִּי שֹׁמֵ֗עַ בְּ/עֵ֛ת קָרְאָ֥/ם אֵלַ֖/י בְּעַ֥ד רָעָתָֽ/ם׃ ס
Jer 11:14.e: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

Jer 7:24.o: וְ/לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְ/לֹֽא־הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־אָזְנָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עֵצ֔וֹת בִּ/שְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֣/ם הָ/רָ֑ע וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ לְ/אָח֖וֹר וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/פָנִֽים׃
Jer 7:24.e: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

Jer 11:8.o: וְ/לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְ/לֹֽא־הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־אָזְנָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אִ֕ישׁ בִּ/שְׁרִיר֖וּת לִבָּ֣/ם הָ/רָ֑ע וָ/אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶֽת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֧י הַ/בְּרִית־הַ/זֹּ֛את אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּ֥יתִי לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א עָשֽׂוּ׃ ס
Jer 11:8.e: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”

Jer 7:30.o: כִּֽי־עָשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֥ה הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינַ֖/י נְאֻום־יְהוָ֑ה שָׂ֣מוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא־שְׁמִ֥/י עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/טַמְּאֽ/וֹ׃
Jer 7:30.e: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says Yahweh. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

Jer 32:34.o: וַ/יָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֥/י עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/טַמְּאֽ/וֹ׃
Jer 32:34.e: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

Jer 19:5.o: וּ/בָנ֞וּ אֶת־בָּמ֣וֹת הַ/בַּ֗עַל לִ/שְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת־בְּנֵי/הֶ֛ם בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ עֹל֣וֹת לַ/בָּ֑עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־צִוִּ֨יתִי֙ וְ/לֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתִּי וְ/לֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־לִבִּֽ/י׃ פ
Jer 19:5.e: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

Jer 7:32.o: לָ/כֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹא־יֵאָמֵ֨ר ע֤וֹד הַ/תֹּ֨פֶת֙ וְ/גֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם כִּ֖י אִם־גֵּ֣יא הַ/הֲרֵגָ֑ה וְ/קָבְר֥וּ בְ/תֹ֖פֶת מֵ/אֵ֥ין מָקֽוֹם׃
Jer 7:32.e: Therefore behold, the days come”, says Yahweh, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

Jer 19:6.o: לָ/כֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹא־יִקָּרֵא֩ לַ/מָּק֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֥ה ע֛וֹד הַ/תֹּ֖פֶת וְ/גֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֑ם כִּ֖י אִם־גֵּ֥יא הַ/הֲרֵגָֽה׃
Jer 19:6.e: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.

Jer 19:7.o: וּ֠/בַקֹּתִי אֶת־עֲצַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הִפַּלְתִּ֤י/ם בַּ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־נִבְלָתָ/ם֙ לְ/מַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃
Jer 19:7.e: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

Jer 7:34.o: וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֣י ׀ מֵ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וּ/מֵֽ/חֻצוֹת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה כִּ֥י לְ/חָרְבָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃
Jer 7:34.e: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”

Jer 16:9.o: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֨י מַשְׁבִּ֜ית מִן־הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בִֽ/ימֵי/כֶ֑ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ/ק֥וֹל כַּלָּֽה׃
Jer 16:9.e: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

Jer 25:10.o: וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֣י מֵ/הֶ֗ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה ק֥וֹל רֵחַ֖יִם וְ/א֥וֹר נֵֽר׃
Jer 25:10.e: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

Jer 33:11.o: ק֣וֹל שָׂשׂ֞וֹן וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֗ה ק֣וֹל חָתָן֮ וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּלָּה֒ ק֣וֹל אֹמְרִ֡ים הוֹדוּ֩ אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת כִּֽי־ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔/וֹ מְבִאִ֥ים תּוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־אָשִׁ֧יב אֶת־שְׁבוּת־הָ/אָ֛רֶץ כְּ/בָ/רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ ס
Jer 33:11.e: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to Yahweh of Armies, for Yahweh is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into Yahweh’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says Yahweh.

Jer 8:15.o: קַוֵּ֥ה לְ/שָׁל֖וֹם וְ/אֵ֣ין ט֑וֹב לְ/עֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה׃
Jer 8:15.e: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

Jer 14:19.o: הֲ/מָאֹ֨ס מָאַ֜סְתָּ אֶת־יְהוּדָ֗ה אִם־בְּ/צִיּוֹן֙ גָּעֲלָ֣ה נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ הִכִּיתָ֔/נוּ וְ/אֵ֥ין לָ֖/נוּ מַרְפֵּ֑א קַוֵּ֤ה לְ/שָׁלוֹם֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין ט֔וֹב וּ/לְ/עֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖א וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה׃
Jer 14:19.e: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

Jer 9:14.o: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֧י מַאֲכִילָ֛/ם אֶת־הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְ/הִשְׁקִיתִ֖י/ם מֵי־רֹֽאשׁ׃
Jer 9:14.e: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

Jer 23:15.o: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ עַל־הַ/נְּבִאִ֔ים הִנְ/נִ֨י מַאֲכִ֤יל אוֹתָ/ם֙ לַֽעֲנָ֔ה וְ/הִשְׁקִתִ֖י/ם מֵי־רֹ֑אשׁ כִּ֗י מֵ/אֵת֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם יָצְאָ֥ה חֲנֻפָּ֖ה לְ/כָל־הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃ פ
Jer 23:15.e: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”

Jer 10:12.o: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/כֹח֔/וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּ/חָכְמָת֑/וֹ וּ/בִ/תְבוּנָת֖/וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
Jer 10:12.e: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.

Jer 51:15.o: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/כֹח֔/וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּ/חָכְמָת֑/וֹ וּ/בִ/תְבוּנָת֖/וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
Jer 51:15.e: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

Jer 10:13.o: לְ/ק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜/וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יַּעֲלֶ֥ה נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִ/קְצֵ֣ה ארץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַ/מָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵ/אֹצְרֹתָֽי/ו׃
Jer 10:13.e: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

Jer 51:16.o: לְ/ק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜/וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יַּ֥עַל נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִ/קְצֵה־אָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַ/מָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֥צֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵ/אֹצְרֹתָֽי/ו׃
Jer 51:16.e: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

Ps 135:7.o: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִ/קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫/אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַ/מָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ר֝וּחַ מֵ/אֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽי/ו׃
Ps 135:7.e: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

Jer 10:14.o: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־אָדָם֙ מִ/דַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־צוֹרֵ֖ף מִ/פָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא־ר֥וּחַ בָּֽ/ם׃
Jer 10:14.e: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

Jer 51:17.o: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־אָדָם֙ מִ/דַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־צֹרֵ֖ף מִ/פָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא־ר֥וּחַ בָּֽ/ם׃
Jer 51:17.e: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

Jer 10:15.o: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּ/עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
Jer 10:15.e: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.

Jer 51:18.o: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּ/עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
Jer 51:18.e: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.

Jer 10:16.o: לֹֽא־כְ/אֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּֽי־יוֹצֵ֤ר הַ/כֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְ/יִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁ֖בֶט נַֽחֲלָת֑/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ׃ ס
Jer 10:16.e: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

Jer 51:19.o: לֹֽא־כְ/אֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲק֗וֹב כִּֽי־יוֹצֵ֤ר הַ/כֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְ/שֵׁ֖בֶט נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ׃ ס
Jer 51:19.e: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

Jer 10:25.o: שְׁפֹ֣ךְ חֲמָתְ/ךָ֗ עַל־הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יְדָע֔וּ/ךָ וְ/עַל֙ מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א קָרָ֑אוּ כִּֽי־אָכְל֣וּ אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַ/אֲכָלֻ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יְכַלֻּ֔/הוּ וְ/אֶת־נָוֵ֖/הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃ פ
Jer 10:25.e: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

Ps 79:6.o: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְ/ךָ֨ אֶֽל־הַ/גּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא־יְדָ֫ע֥וּ/ךָ וְ/עַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝/שִׁמְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃
Ps 79:6.e: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

Jer 11:20.o: וַֽ/יהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שֹׁפֵ֣ט צֶ֔דֶק בֹּחֵ֥ן כְּלָי֖וֹת וָ/לֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־רִיבִֽ/י׃ ס
Jer 11:20.e: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.

Jer 20:12.o: וַ/יהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן צַדִּ֔יק רֹאֶ֥ה כְלָי֖וֹת וָ/לֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־רִיבִֽ/י׃ ס
Jer 20:12.e: But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.

Jer 15:13.o: חֵילְ/ךָ֧ וְ/אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֛י/ךָ לָ/בַ֥ז אֶתֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א בִ/מְחִ֑יר וּ/בְ/כָל־חַטֹּאותֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/בְ/כָל־גְּבוּלֶֽי/ךָ׃
Jer 15:13.e: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

Jer 17:3.o: הֲרָרִ/י֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה חֵילְ/ךָ֥ כָל־אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ לָ/בַ֣ז אֶתֵּ֑ן בָּמֹתֶ֕י/ךָ בְּ/חַטָּ֖את בְּ/כָל־גְּבוּלֶֽי/ךָ׃
Jer 17:3.e: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

Jer 15:14.o: וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֹ֣יְבֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי־אֵ֛שׁ קָדְחָ֥ה בְ/אַפִּ֖/י עֲלֵי/כֶ֥ם תּוּקָֽד׃ ס
Jer 15:14.e: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”

Jer 17:4.o: וְ/שָׁמַטְתָּ֗ה וּ/בְ/ךָ֙ מִ/נַּחֲלָֽתְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔/ךְ וְ/הַעֲבַדְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת־אֹ֣יְבֶ֔י/ךָ בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי־אֵ֛שׁ קְדַחְתֶּ֥ם בְּ/אַפִּ֖/י עַד־עוֹלָ֥ם תּוּקָֽד׃ ס
Jer 17:4.e: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”

Jer 16:4.o: מְמוֹתֵ֨י תַחֲלֻאִ֜ים יָמֻ֗תוּ לֹ֤א יִסָּֽפְדוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְ/דֹ֛מֶן עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְי֑וּ וּ/בַ/חֶ֤רֶב וּ/בָֽ/רָעָב֙ יִכְל֔וּ וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָ/ם֙ לְ/מַאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃ ס
Jer 16:4.e: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

Jer 34:20.o: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אוֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָ/ם֙ לְ/מַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃
Jer 34:20.e: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

Jer 16:14.o: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא־יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ חַי־יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
Jer 16:14.e: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that it will no more be said, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

Jer 23:7.o: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹא־יֹ֤אמְרוּ עוֹד֙ חַי־יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
Jer 23:7.e: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

Jer 16:15.o: כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱלָ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדִּיחָ֖/ם שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וַ/הֲשִֽׁבֹתִי/ם֙ עַל־אַדְמָתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַ/אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם׃ ס
Jer 16:15.e: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

Jer 23:8.o: כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת־זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָ/ה וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖י/ם שָׁ֑ם וְ/יָשְׁב֖וּ עַל־אַדְמָתָֽ/ם׃ ס
Jer 23:8.e: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”

Jer 19:8.o: וְ/שַׂמְתִּי֙ אֶת־הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את לְ/שַׁמָּ֖ה וְ/לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְ/יִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־כָּל־מַכֹּתֶֽ/הָ׃
Jer 19:8.e: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

Jer 49:17.o: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה אֱד֖וֹם לְ/שַׁמָּ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְ/יִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־כָּל־מַכּוֹתֶֽ/הָ׃
Jer 49:17.e: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

Jer 19:13.o: וְ/הָי֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּ/בָתֵּי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ/מְק֥וֹם הַ/תֹּ֖פֶת הַ/טְּמֵאִ֑ים לְ/כֹ֣ל הַ/בָּתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטְּר֜וּ עַל־גַּגֹּֽתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/כֹל֙ צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/הַסֵּ֥ךְ נְסָכִ֖ים לֵ/אלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃ פ
Jer 19:13.e: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”

Jer 32:29.o: וּ/בָ֣אוּ הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַ/נִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל־הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת־הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ וּ/שְׂרָפ֑וּ/הָ וְ/אֵ֣ת הַ/בָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ קִטְּר֨וּ עַל־גַּגּֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֜ם לַ/בַּ֗עַל וְ/הִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽ/נִי׃
Jer 32:29.e: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

Jer 21:9.o: הַ/יֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר וְ/הַ/יּוֹצֵא֩ וְ/נָפַ֨ל עַל־הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַ/צָּרִ֤ים עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ יחיה וְ/הָֽיְתָה־לּ֥/וֹ נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ לְ/שָׁלָֽל׃
Jer 21:9.e: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.

Jer 38:2.o: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ הַ/יֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בָּ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר וְ/הַ/יֹּצֵ֤א אֶל־הַ/כַּשְׂדִּים֙ יחיה וְ/הָיְתָה־לּ֥/וֹ נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ לְ/שָׁלָ֖ל וָ/חָֽי׃ ס
Jer 38:2.e: “Yahweh says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’

Jer 23:19.o: הִנֵּ֣ה ׀ סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה וְ/סַ֖עַר מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃
Jer 23:19.e: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.

Jer 30:23.o: הִנֵּ֣ה ׀ סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה סַ֖עַר מִתְגּוֹרֵ֑ר עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃
Jer 30:23.e: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.

Jer 23:20.o: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אַף־יְהוָ֔ה עַד־עֲשֹׂת֥/וֹ וְ/עַד־הֲקִימ֖/וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑/וֹ בְּ/אַֽחֲרִית֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָ֖/הּ בִּינָֽה׃
Jer 23:20.e: Yahweh’s anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.

Jer 30:24.o: לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־יְהוָ֔ה עַד־עֲשֹׂת֥/וֹ וְ/עַד־הֲקִימ֖/וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑/וֹ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית הַ/יָּמִ֖ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָֽ/הּ׃
Jer 30:24.e: The fierce anger of Yahweh will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”

Jer 24:8.o: וְ/כַ/תְּאֵנִים֙ הָֽ/רָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵ/רֹ֑עַ כִּי־כֹ֣ה ׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כֵּ֣ן אֶ֠תֵּן אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֤ה וְ/אֶת־שָׂרָי/ו֙ וְ/אֵ֣ת ׀ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִים֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
